title: Kadri M Probable NDE 6431
content: Here is a clip on YouTube of me standing by this very same river and talking about my experience. I was seven years old and, as children usually are at that age, I wanted to be like the other children around me. By this time, I had already noticed that I was different from other children in my town because of my financial status.) My meeting with God in an out-of-body experience happened, I think because of my natural childish idea that I could prove to the other children that whatever they could do, I could do, too. I crossed the river from one side to the other, just like they did. But when they got to the other side, they kept on walking toward their homes. I remember so clearly that when I arrived on the other side, I suddenly realized that 'Oops, I have to turn around and go back!' so I could go home. I was already tired because the water was so deep that it took all my strength to get through it. You can get a feeling of what it was like for a seven-year-old girl to walk through this river. It's not very wide, but it runs deep as it cuts through the meadow. On my way back, right in middle of pushing my way back through the river's water, I suddenly felt myself so tired that I sat down in the water right where I was. I can't explain how I left my body, but it reminds me of John 8:51 'Truly, I say unto you, anyone who keeps my word, he shall never see death.' I remember that suddenly I was in Heaven, standing before an angel who was holding the Book of the Lamb. To me, it seemed to be a wonderfully friendly place. Of course, I was surprised to be there, but I really liked it from the first moment of my arrival. While I was looking around and getting know the place, suddenly I heard a man's voice saying to me, 'You need to go back. Your time has not yet come!' I didn't see who was talking to me, but I felt his voice echoing deep down inside my body. Right away, I was back on Earth where my body was. When I saw my body with bubbles coming out of it, I knew what had happened. Then, as I was looking at my body, I was somehow back inside it again. I realized that no one had discovered me yet, so I stood up in the water like nothing had happened. And because what I had experienced had been very shocking to me, I ran home as fast as I could and rushed into my house without saying anything to anyone. It reminds to me of what is written in Isaiah 43:2: 'Even when you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you will not drown.'

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: She says, 'I can't explain how I left my body.'

arrival.other_being_detail: An angel was 'holding the Book of the Lamb.' A disembodied/unseen man's voice told her to return.

environment.environment_other_detail: She describes being 'in Heaven' and that it seemed 'to be a wonderfully friendly place.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: She became exhausted while crossing back through a deep river, sat down in the water, and later saw her body with bubbles coming out of it (suggesting drowning).

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred while in the river; she reports arriving in Heaven and encountering an angel; then a disembodied voice told her to go back; she returned immediately and re-entered her body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Angel holding 'the Book of the Lamb'; return instruction delivered by an unseen man's voice that 'echo[ed] deep down inside my body.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “You need to go back. Your time has not yet come!”; “When I saw my body with bubbles coming out of it, I knew what had happened.”
